gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-alexandria: Galaxy lays down one uninterrupted line width across every letter, spaced loose and wide like a stencil brush on a wall. And Alexandria, a sans with open terminals on its c, answers that boldness with tidy, tall-bodied text.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-amiko:
Galaxy draws every stroke the same, up or sideways, with no give.

Amiko, a plain sans with outward-pointing terminals, takes over beneath it and gives the page a tall, crayon-sturdy lowercase to rest on after the heading's wide, dense stripes.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-bangla: Galaxy is a plain stripe of constant ink, loosely spaced, with a dense lowercase band that gives its headings a cosmic weight. Anek Bangla, a sans-serif, can run a touch larger.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari reads with distinctly open letter mouths and a tall middle zone, a sans that never feels cramped. Galaxy above it has no modulation at all, so give the body a little extra size.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-gujarati: Galaxy gives each line a smooth, tube-like look, dense in the lowercase and generously spaced. And Anek Gujarati, a plain sans with a gaping c and lowercase that rivals its capitals, would read freely over many lines.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-gurmukhi:
Galaxy looks drawn with a compass pencil, every line the same.

Anek Gurmukhi, a sans-serif, fills in beneath with big open counters and generous round curves, so the cosmic, dense heading gets a roomy, friendly counterpart below it.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-kannada: Dense, loose, and cosmic, Galaxy frames its counters with strokes of one width and lets the headline command attention. Anek Kannada, a sans with a high, woodblock-square x-height and terminals stopping far from the stem, does the quieter work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin is a sans with tall lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals and shapes held open rather than curled shut. But Galaxy does the loud work, bold letters with no thick or thin strokes, spaced loosely.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam reads in a plain sans manner, with almost no gap between x-height and caps and curve tips that never touch. Galaxy handles impact with constant-width lines, while the body font handles the steady reading.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-odia:
Galaxy, thick and cosmic, with crossbars as heavy as its stems.

Anek Odia follows with a sans whose rounds stay unlatched and whose capitals barely clear the lowercase, so the loose, dense heading gives way to something much lighter on the page.
